verified_source_groups: town-centre, site-allocation and opportunity-area design evidence
libraries, community halls, primary healthcare and primary-school coverage gaps
allotment, play-space, cemetery, sport, playing-field and religious-ground design evidence
authoritative ACV point/status examples and CIL schedule document examples

accuracy_notes: Archived or design-stage town-centre and site-allocation evidence was not treated as adopted policy or exact parcel geometry.
The zero-record local-green-space dataset was retained as a coverage gap and never interpreted as absence of designation.

Asset-of-community-value examples were separated by decision and expiry state; expired records were rejected for current use and successful point records were not promoted without legal notices and exact property geometry.
CIL schedule document records were not converted into rates or liability without current legal schedules, amendments, indexation, charging-zone geometry, development use and floorspace.
Libraries, community halls, healthcare, schools and recreation design surfaces were retained as service-coverage gaps and not converted into amenity or accessibility scores.
No parcel relation, future-growth score or business row was fabricated.
